name: Tourist Trap
source:
Your spaceship is down again, and the only place to turn is a market full of questionable shopkeepers. Crystals, food, trinkets – choose wisely, or risk a very bad ending.

[From [url=https://infinitestrike.itch.io/tourist-trap]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的宇宙飞船再次坠落，唯一的出路就是充满可疑店主的市场。水晶、食物、饰品——明智地选择，否则就会有非常糟糕的结局。

[来自[url=https://infinitestrike.itch.io/tourist-trap]Itch.io[/url]]
